## Parent

[Infrastructure discovery specification](https://github.com/Fardinak/torob-aipe-challenge/issues/12)

## What to build

Give buyers all qualifying managed database offerings from selected Iranian sources across their engines and configurations, backed by reviewed evidence and visible service distinctions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Conduct and document a broad source search beyond the historical shortlist, retaining source-selection and provider/engine inclusion/exclusion reasons, access limitations and evidence gaps.
- [ ] Inspect all managed database offerings at selected sources across engines. Gather every qualifying published configuration without a PostgreSQL-only boundary, fixed engine whitelist, arbitrary provider/configuration ceiling or two-by-two stopping rule.
- [ ] Stop only after the documented breadth search stops uncovering meaningful additional coverage and all qualifying offerings at selected sources have been covered; retain an assessable stopping rationale.
- [ ] Require a public numeric tariff applicable to the identified engine/configuration, first-party evidence/check date, handoff link and documented management beyond provisioning. Generic database tariffs must not be silently assumed to apply to every advertised engine.
- [ ] Preserve engine/version, resources, hardware/feature package, topology, location, backups, management responsibility, billing and mandatory-charge unknowns. Coming-soon, unpriced or unverified products do not become admitted priced offers.
- [ ] Publish admitted data and retained evidence into usable managed database listing items and provider-offer details, with separate same-engine comparisons. Recheck historical Liara/ManageIT/ArvanCloud leads without treating earlier observations as permanent approvals or exclusions.
- [ ] Actively seek genuine exact cross-provider configurations using engine, exact resources/storage type and topology. Record supported matches and evidence gaps; unknown versions cannot satisfy version filters and unknown grouping facts cannot prove a match.
- [ ] Retain progress for resumable acquisition. Use existing catalog validation and representative multi-engine rendering/filter checks instead of one suite per engine/provider. Synthetic fixtures never count as catalog breadth or real matches.
- [ ] Do not create accounts, purchase or contact providers; any evidence-backed inability to meet agreed scope must return to the human before scope is reduced.

#20 VPS acquisition is implemented on main at fe40fd2492936cf669ec4f93d715ec0ae82fd860. [Search, stopping assessment and exact overlaps](https://github.com/Fardinak/torob-aipe-challenge/blob/fe40fd2492936cf669ec4f93d715ec0ae82fd860/research/vps-breadth-review-2026-10-29.md).

Real verified VPS overlaps include IranVM/MehranHost 1 CPU / 1 GB / 10 GB NVMe, Hostida/Mobinhost 2 CPU / 4 GB / 40 GB SSD and Spadserver/OnlineServer 2 CPU / 2 GB / 35 GB SSD. Provider-specific prices/billing/traffic/extras remain distinct. Static catalog and retained evidence are published together; 40 unit tests and 13 desktop/mobile journeys passed.

This establishes the VPS category match. It does not complete managed-database acquisition (#21) or integrated release/deployed validation (#22); retain those obligations and the parent release gate.
